[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/alloc/callback.lani#L23)

Layer: `alloc`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Stored move closures with uniform Callback<T,U>, Source<U>, Handler<T> and Action signatures. Native x86_64 invocation through compiler-generated three-pointer entries; Wasm rejects the indirect call. Manual destroy frees the callback block, not resources owned by captures. Copies alias the block and must not be called concurrently. Allocation failure traps. Closure results must be explicit block types, or void blocks. The focused language fixture executes returned callbacks, heterogeneous closure types, struct arguments, trait forwarding and explicit destruction. UI scope ownership is a separate integration task.
